body:
Leonard,

The fundraising section is done. "Fundraising - Oct 14 board" is in my Board - Oct 14 2025 folder: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/f1400ba55635cdb3/edit

Numbers for the fundraising slide (as of EOD Tue Sep 30 PT):
- Firms on the sheet: 79 (the 77 unique names on the 2025 list, angels included, plus Homa and Brightwater Games Fund, who we've had calls with since Sep 3)
- Committed: $25,000 (Anton Bernstein's SAFE at $25K; the DocuSign Completed notice came in Sep 26)
- Soft-circled: $50,000 (Paul Heydon; his SAFE is still unsigned in DocuSign)

Breakdown: 9 in talks, 8 passed, 14 awaiting reply, 48 not contacted this round.
In talks: Anton, Paul, GFR, a16z, Dentsu, T-Accelerate, NCsoft, Homa, Brightwater.
Build access: T-Accelerate has iOS and Android, Dentsu has iOS only (Play isn't added yet), and the rest have none.

On the Existing Investor Update card I added a Keep warm checklist with LVP, Hiro Capital and SciPlay. Those are the three that passed after a pitch call this round. The email-only no's (Play, 1AM/March, Grishin, Lakestar, Iamgaming) aren't on it.

A few calls you may want to check before Monday:
- a16z is in talks. The speedrun interview counts as our call, but the cohort decision isn't their answer on the bridge.
- Initial Capital is awaiting reply. "Won't lead, might write a small check" came with no amount, so it isn't soft-circled.
- I labeled list row 69 (Gorkem Turk) as Iamgaming.

Per your note, it's not going to the board directly.

Fred
